author: Seung Wook
problem: A ski pass is valid from day pass_start through day pass_end, and a visitor stays from day arrive through day leave. Return how many days of the stay the pass covers.
bug_description: Adds the + 1 outside max(0, ...), so when the stay and the pass don't overlap at all it returns 1 instead of 0.

comments.accurate: Days of the stay that fall on days the pass is valid
comments.wrong_behavior: Days the pass covers; a stay always gets at least its first day on the pass
comments.wrong_location: Day count verified; check the overlap takes the later start and the earlier end
